tagline: Global leader in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Aftermarket revenue represents 36.5% of the company's total revenue in 2025, generating a significant recurring revenue stream through the installed product base and standard customer replacement cycles.
company_description: Ingersoll Rand Inc. provides mission-critical air, fluid, clean energy, and medical technologies services and solutions worldwide. It operates in two segments, Industrial Technologies and Services, and Precision and Science Technologies. The Industrial Technologies and Services segment designs, manufactures, markets, and services a range of air and gas compression and treatment equipment, vacuum and blower products, fluid transfer equipment, loading systems, and power tools and lifting equipment; and other specialized equipment, including aftermarket parts, consumables and services, air treatment equipment, controls, other accessories, and services under the Ingersoll Rand, Gardner Denver, Nash, CompAir, Elmo Rietschle, and other brands. risks.title: Economic Fluctuations and Capital Spending
risks.summary: Economic fluctuations can have a significant impact on the company's financial results through changes in customer capital expenditure patterns.
risks.score_rationale: The company's financial results closely follow changes in general economic conditions and capital spending levels in the industries it serves. Demand for most products depends on new capital investment and maintenance expenditures by customers. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Foreign Currency Fluctuations
risks.summary: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations can impact operating results due to significant international revenue and cost exposure.
risks.score_rationale: A significant portion of revenues (54% for year ended December 31, 2025) is denominated in currencies other than the U.S. dollar, and much of manufacturing and labor costs are also outside the U.S., creating exposure to exchange rate movements. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: Intense competition can significantly impact market share and pricing power in the company's operating segments.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in highly competitive markets where it faces competition on product quality, reliability, pricing, and service responsiveness. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.summary: Dependence on technology systems creates vulnerability to security failures and operational interruptions.
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on technology for its operations, making systems vulnerable to security breaches and operational disruptions. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.summary: Regulatory changes can impact operations and financial results across the company's global footprint.
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the countries where it operates, which can impact operations and financial results. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.summary: Supply chain disruptions could impact the company's ability to manufacture and deliver products to customers.
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on suppliers for raw materials and components such as steel, aluminum, copper, and castings, making operations vulnerable to supply chain disruptions. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.summary: Reputation damage could significantly impact customer relationships and financial performance given brand reliance.
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation for product quality, reliability, and service is essential to maintaining long-standing customer relationships and market positions. Incidents could significantly impact financial results. (default score, to be refined)
